1.The Company has only one business segment namely "Cementitious Materials".
2a. During the Year ended March 31, 2024, the Company (Holding Company), upon signing of a Share Purchase and Shareholders Agreement (SPA) dated February 9, 2024, had acquired 85% equity stake in Agrani Cement Private Limited (and its three wholly owned subsidiaries, together known as "Trivikram Consortium") for Rs. 325.11 Crore. The Trivikram Consortium had earlier been awarded an MDO Contract for three limestone mines in the State of Assam (approx. 335 MT reserves) by Assam Mineral Development Corporation Limited (AMDCL).
During the year ended March 31, 2026, AMDCL cancelled the aforesaid MDO Contract on the ground of non-compliance by the Trivikram Consortium for inducting the Company as an Equity Partner. Consequently, during the Quarter/ Year ended March 31, 2026, the Company has recognized the amount of Rs. 130 Crore paid as Claims Recoverable & written back the unpaid liability of Rs 195 Crore as an Exceptional Item and derecognized the Investment of Rs. 325 Crore as an Exceptional Item in the Standalone Financial Results. The Company has also de-recognized the corresponding Mining Rights as stated above of Rs. 325 Crore in the Consolidated Financial Results of Quarter and Year ended March 31, 2026.
2b. During the Quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Arbitral Tribunal was constituted and Hon’ble Delhi High Court directed that the application earlier filed by the Company with Delhi High Court under Section 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 for securing the recovery of above amount so paid be placed before the Arbitral Tribunal. The Company has filed its Statement of Claims against the Seller (Respondents) before the Arbitral Tribunal for the aforesaid amount of Rs. 130 Crore along with other claims & damages. The Arbitral Tribunal in its hearing held on September 8, 2026 has directed the Respondents to file their Written Statement / Statement of Defence, Replies and Counter Claims to the Application on or before November 5, 2026 and Claimants may file their reply to the Counter Claim and Rejoinder to the Statement of Defence on or before November 26, 2026. The Arbitral Tribunal has listed the matter on January 6, 2027 for hearing.
Based on the Legal Opinion & Assessment of the terms of SPA, the Management is confident of recovering the amount of Rs. 130 Crore and the same is considered good for recovery.
3. The figures for the previous periods have been regrouped / rearranged wherever necessary.
4. The above results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 04, 2026. The Auditors of the Company have carried out a "Limited Review" of the same.
